迹只取同一行列标签处的元素。H1x 和 H2x 是不同基矢，不能把它们之间的 −: The trace takes entries with identical row and column labels. H1x and H2x are different basis vectors, so their −1 coefficient is not a diagonal contribution.
正确。A₁ 的维度为 1，2 表示两个副本。对称性允许它们混合，也允许其频率不同: Correct. A₁ has dimension 1, and 2 counts copies. Symmetry permits mixing and different frequencies; frequencies require force-constant information.
